pick.name: Gmail (personal) + Outlook (company), each in its own browser profile; Gemini in Gmail + Claude Gmail connector for triage
pick.what: Keep two native web inboxes; use Gemini in Gmail (AI Pro) for summaries/drafts and Claude's read-only Gmail connector for cross-thread questions
pick.why: No new client to trust, keeps company and personal mail separated, and uses AI you already pay for (Gemini AI Pro, Claude Max)
pick.free_limits: Gmail free; Gemini AI Inbox/Q&A on AI Pro (US-first rollout Jan 2026); Claude Gmail connector on Pro/Max, read-only (cannot send/modify)

alts.name: Thunderbird (153 ESR)
alts.what: Open-source desktop mail client; native Exchange (EWS) mail since 145
alts.why: Best if you want one local client for several personal accounts; Exchange Online EWS was slated for shutdown from 2026-10-01, so do not rely on it for M365

alts.name: Shortwave
alts.why: Best AI triage UX for Gmail if you outgrow Gemini; sources conflict on whether a free tier still exists
alts.free_limits: Unclear: some 2026 sources list a free tier (90-day search, 1 account), others say trial only

candidates.name: Gmail + Outlook web (separate profiles)
candidates.verdict: PICK: zero new tools, strongest separation, uses owned AI

candidates.name: Thunderbird
candidates.verdict: Good free multi-account client; EWS for Exchange Online retiring, Graph not yet enabled

candidates.name: Superhuman Mail
candidates.verdict: Grammarly rebranded as Superhuman (Oct 2025); Mail in paid Business tier; overkill

candidates.name: New Outlook for Windows
candidates.verdict: Can add Gmail, but on a work machine it mixes personal mail into a company-managed client

decision: The best setup is not a new client: personal Gmail and company Outlook stay in separate browser profiles, with Gemini for in-inbox summaries and Claude's Gmail connector for 'what did X say' questions. Use Thunderbird only for extra personal IMAP accounts. Revisit Shortwave if Gmail volume becomes a daily bottleneck.
details: Gemini AI Inbox availability in India is not confirmed. Claude M365 connector exists for the company side but needs tenant admin enablement.

verify.note: Claude Gmail connector confirmed read-only on Pro/Max/Team/Enterprise. Gemini AI Inbox India availability still unverified.
